name: NAPALM
description: Network Automation and Programmability Abstraction Layer with Multivendor support. Provides a unified Python API to interact with different network device vendors for configuration management and state retrieval.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile in develop branch. NAPALM Inspector deployable with make docker and make start.

eval_notes: Unified API for multi-vendor network device interaction. Key for evaluations involving network configuration retrieval and device state verification. Dockerfile in repo for containerized deployment. Unified API across vendors for get_config, load_merge_candidate, compare_config, commit_config. Uses NETCONF for Junos, SSH for others. Commonly paired with Nornir and containerlab. Widely adopted multi-vendor network automation library. NETCONF support via IOS-XR driver. Unified getter/config API enables vendor-agnostic testing. Strong community ecosystem.
